lawyer:
Md Nawab Ali, Advocate-on-Record--For the Petitioners.

parties:
Kulsuma Khatun ------ Petitioner
vs
Rahman Sobhan ------ Respondent
full_judgment: 5. Mr Md Nawab Ali, the learned Advocate-on-Record for the petitioners, submits that the case of the defendant-respondent Nos. 1 and 2 before the trial Court was that the summons was not duly served on them and that they were not aware of the institution of the suit but they did not claim in their petition that their addresses given in the cause-title of the suit was wrong but in spite of this position the learned Subordinate Judge as well as the learned Single Judge of the High Court Division committed an error of law resulting in an error in the decision occasioning failure of justice in making out a third case. He lastly, submits that the Single Bench of the High Court Division committed an error of law affirming the judgment and order of the appellate Court below without any legal and valid reasonings. Therefore the judgment of the High Court Division is liable to be set aside for the ends of justice.
